profile.headline: Software Engineer | AI Tools | Android
profile.summary: Android and developer platform engineer with 12+ years at Google, Life360, and IXL Learning. Tech lead for Android Google Maps location sharing; built Google's Android library release automation. Mentored engineers, conducted 100+ interviews at Google, and managed a mobile engineering team. Currently building internal MCP servers and AI-agent tooling at Life360, and leading in-app purchase and external billing.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Engineered and deployed a map annotation service using geospatial indexing; reduced network load by 80% and load time from 2 seconds to 100 milliseconds.
• Built internal MCP servers that let AI coding agents run end-to-end and UI tests on phones, replacing manual on-device test runs; adopted by the mobile and QA teams.
• Tech lead for a price increase across Android, iOS, and web, adding $19M in annual revenue; led in-app purchase and external billing.
• Led 911 incident display on the main map (e.g., fires, stabbings), alerting users when one is near a family member; the map is the default screen for Life360's 100M+ monthly active users.
positions.insights: Skills: Android · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Model Context Protocol (MCP)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Google Play - GMSCore
• Built automation used by 100+ internal teams for all of Google's Android libraries on Maven: creation, dependency management, testing, licensing, approvals, and release
• Release manager for all maven.google.com libraries
• Managed Lint infrastructure for Google Play Services producing tens of thousands of findings daily and decreased unhelpful findings by 50%

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Google Maps (Geo). Promoted from Software Engineer to Senior Software Engineer.
• Tech lead for Android development of core features on Google Maps: location sharing, personal score, & local guide content following
• Built the location sharing integration platform used by Google Maps and Google's Personal Safety app, clearing privacy, legal, and security review
• Managed transition to no longer requiring Location History for location shares
• Led Kotlin adoption in Google Maps (Android), taught seminars, and managed the rollout on a 15-year-old & 400-engineer codebase; all teams moved to Kotlin, now used for all new code

positions.title: Engineering Manager - Mobile
positions.description:
• Increased app stability from 94% to 99% crash-free sessions by improving processes, including standardizing code reviews and fostering a culture of automated testing
• Managed the IXL iOS and Android apps with over 250k daily active users
• Improved feature implementation time and code quality while reducing technical debt in legacy codebases
• Grew team from 2 to 6 engineers by streamlining recruiting flow and reducing candidate turnaround time
• Led process migration from Waterfall to Agile Scrum workflow
• Managed large cross-team projects with mobile, content, core tech, and product engineering teams
• Balanced iOS and Android projects with a diversely skilled team

positions.title: Software Engineer - Mobile
positions.description:
• Led company-wide training on Reactive Extensions with emphasis on RxJava, RxSwift, and RxJS
• Triaged incoming bugs, determined priority and impact
• Implemented auto-renewing subscriptions through iTunes and in-app purchases
• Created infrastructure for continuous integration with unit, instrumented, and UI tests
• Improved and monitored tracking of app usage and crashes
• Managed releases on the Apple App Store, Google Play, and Amazon App Store

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Created A-Maze-ing Mazes, an Android maze game, published on Google Play
• Developed Point of Sale Android application and server backend for a local non-profit

positions.title: Assistant Language Teacher
positions.description:
• Led English programs for over 300 students across 3 elementary schools in Japan
• Developed a phonics curriculum for 5th and 6th grade-level students that increased reading comprehension 2 years above standards

positions.title: Volunteer English Teacher
positions.description: I successfully captured students’ attention with innovative lessons in classes that were traditionally extremely disruptive.

positions.title: Senior Thesis
positions.description:
Title: Recovering Three Dimensional Structure from a Pair of Images

• Built a program in Python/Sage that uses point correspondence information to reconstruct 3D structure
• Resolved all unknowns, such as camera calibration, without any a priori knowledge of the scene
• Led weekly meetings to report on progress, problem solve, plan, and set deadlines

positions.title: House Advisor
positions.description: I manged local college student communities. My responsibilities included peer-counseling, planning community events, and enforcement of community rules.

positions.title: Teacher Assistant
positions.description:
• Provided support to students in the Introduction to Computing class
• Managed computer labs, held office hours for drop-in tutoring, and graded assignments
• Had record drop-in tutoring attendance, twice that of other Teacher Assistants for the same course

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
I assisted the Biology Department in linking specific genes with maternal behavior of African cichlid fish through statistical analysis of experimental data using R.

There were thousands of different genes to be analyzed, each with unique artifacts introduced in measuring gene expression. I created an easy to use method for the lab that could be used to determine what the best method for normalizing a specific data set is.

• Created key script in R to evaluate normalization methods
• Researched new methods and evaluated established ones for microarray data normalization

publications.title: Recovering Three Dimensional Structure from a Pair of Images
